description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM is a technology and consulting company developing infrastructure, cloud, and AI solutions. The Entry Level Software Developer will design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise software for infrastructure offerings while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
Software engineer building and testing customer-facing applications, APIs, and backend services across the development lifecycle

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software solutions using modern software engineering practices
• Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support
• Collaborate with product management, architects, quality assurance, support, and operations teams to deliver customer-focused solutions
• Develop scalable, secure, and performant applications, services, APIs, and backend components
• Troubleshoot and resolve software defects, performance bottlenecks, and customer-reported issues
• Contribute to architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews
• Create and maintain technical documentation, test plans, and operational procedures
• Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices to improve software quality and delivery efficiency
• Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend improvements to products, processes, and development methodologies
• Support agile development processes and actively participate in sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement activities

Requirements:
• High School Diploma/GED
• • Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, C++, JavaScript, or similar
• • Understanding of software design principles, object-oriented programming, and data structures
• • Experience developing REST APIs, microservices, or distributed systems
• • Knowledge of source control systems such as Git
• • Experience with Linux/Unix environments and command-line tools
• • Understanding of software testing methodologies, debugging, and performance analysis
• • Familiarity with databases, including relational and/or NoSQL technologies
• • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts, containerization, and CI/CD practices

Preferred:
• Bachelor's Degree
• • Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or cloud-native architectures
• • Knowledge of hybrid cloud platforms and infrastructure management solutions
• • Experience with storage, backup, disaster recovery, cybersecurity, or enterprise infrastructure technologies
• • Familiarity with AI/ML, automation frameworks, or agentic AI solutions
• • Experience building highly available, scalable distributed systems
• • Knowledge of observability, monitoring, logging, and site reliability engineering (SRE) practices
• • Experience with DevSecOps, security best practices, and secure software development
• • Familiarity with IBM technologies, Red Hat OpenShift, IBM Cloud, or enterprise software products
